He played college basketball for the [[Tennessee Volunteers basketball|Tennessee Volunteers]].{{cite web|url=https://utsports.com/roster.aspx?rp_id=6744|title=University of Tennessee Athletics|website=utsports.com|accessdate=April 9, 2019}} Bone has a brother Josh and attended [[The Ensworth School]] in [[Nashville, Tennessee]]. He was ranked the 171st overall prospect in his class by 247Sports. As a freshman, he posted 7.2 points and 2.9 assists per game, then as a sophomore averaging 7.3 points and 3.5 assists per game. As a junior, Bone had a breakout season and averaged 13.5 points, 5.8 assists and 3.2 rebounds per game and helped Tennessee to a 31-6 season and a Sweet 16 appearance. {{cite news |last1=Daniels |first1=Ivan |title=Tennessee star guard Jordan Bone declares for NBA Draft |url=https://247sports.com/college/basketball/recruiting/Article/Jordan-Bone-Tennessee-NBA-Draft-130836008/ |accessdate=April 9, 2019 |work=247 Sports |date=April 3, 2019}} He was named to the Second-team All-[[Southeastern Conference|SEC]].
